_note: Irradiated doses of the studies whose doses the ABox codes as dose assessments, with the endpoint and stage each source scored. Doses in roentgens are converted at 8.77 mGy per roentgen. The unirradiated control is left out.

patel2017.scored: plants alive 30 days after sowing, in Petri dishes
patel2017.quote: exposed to different doses of gamma irradiation viz. 150Gy, 200Gy, 250Gy, 300Gy and 350Gy using 60Co as a radiation source

zanzibar2016.scored: germination percentage of fresh seeds in the germination test
zanzibar2016.quote: Seeds were irradiated with 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 Gy by Cobalt-60

mahesha2023.scored: germination seven days after sowing, in Petri plates and polybags
mahesha2023.quote: Seeds of the field bean underwent with diverse dosages of gamma rays (0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and 60kR)

corazonguivin2023.scored: surviving plants per irradiated seed in the greenhouse experiment, with growth recorded 30 days after emergence
corazonguivin2023.quote: Nine treatments with different irradiation doses (0-control, 500, 550, 600, 650, 700, 750, 800, and 900 Gy)

indrayanti2024.scored: seedlings alive four weeks after germination, relative to the control
indrayanti2024.quote: Tomatoes dry seeds were irradiated with 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 110, and 120 Gy of gamma rays

chakraborty2023.quote: the wheat seeds of both varieties were subjected to six different doses, viz., 200, 250, 300, 350, 400 and 450 Gray (Gy)

lumorh2025.scored: germination counted 3 to 18 days after sowing in nursery pots
lumorh2025.quote: Each of the five genotypes had 10 seeds irradiated with 12 radiation doses, ranging from 100 to 1200 Gy
